technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring Boot for developing REST endpoints to ensure consistency with the Spring ecosystem.
Leverage existing Spring XD module architecture for moving Cassandra and analytic-pmml modules to Spring Cloud Stream.
Implement HDFS High Availability support by updating Hadoop client configuration to use HA-aware proxies.
Design REST APIs to return job composition data in JSON format for easy consumption by UI components.
Utilize Spring XD's dashboard or admin interface for UI enhancements, ensuring minimal disruption to existing code.
assumptions: The developer has full access to the Spring XD codebase, including source code, build tools, and development environments.
Existing code is modular and well-documented, allowing for incremental changes without major refactoring.
No significant architectural changes are required; all enhancements are feature additions or bug fixes within the current framework.
Development effort estimates are for one developer, focusing on coding, testing, and basic documentation, excluding deployment or production support.
All user stories are independent and can be implemented in parallel or sequence without critical dependencies affecting effort.

activities.activity_description: Review all user stories, understand requirements, design technical solutions for each feature, and create a detailed implementation plan.
Modify binding configurations and integration code to support connecting to multiple external systems for the same binding type, ensuring data can be read from one and written to another.
Update HDFS client code to support High Availability namenode configuration in custom module locations, replacing non-HA proxy creation with HA-aware methods.
Refactor and move the Cassandra module from Spring XD to Spring Cloud Stream repository, ensuring it functions as a sink for streaming pipelines.
Port the analytic-pmml module from Spring XD to Spring Cloud Stream repository, making it available as a processor module for streaming applications.

activities.activity_name: Implement U5 and U6 - REST Endpoints for Job Composition
activities.activity_description: Develop REST endpoints to return job composition flag and composition graph, providing data for differentiating and visualizing job relationships.

activities.activity_name: Implement U7 and U8 - UI Enhancements
activities.activity_description: Update the UI to visually differentiate between job-composition workflows and single jobs, and enable navigation to detail pages for both singular and composed jobs.
Write and execute unit tests for all implemented features to verify individual components function correctly and handle edge cases.
Perform integration tests to ensure all features work together seamlessly, including interactions between modules, REST endpoints, and UI components.
Update project documentation to reflect changes, refactor code for readability and maintainability, and ensure compliance with coding standards.
